newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia palm oil export prices seen easing -MIER.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia palm oil export prices seen easing -MIER.

text.p: Malaysian palm oil export prices are expected to ease slightly over the next two years, the government-backed Malaysian Institute of Economic Research (MIER) said on Tuesday.

"We estimate export unit value (for palm oil) to be at 1,220 ringgit/tonne in 1996, easing slightly to 1,210 ringgit/tonne in 1997 in view of higher production," the think-tank said in a report on the Malaysian economic outlook.
"In 1998, export unit price is forecast to moderate further to 1,150 ringgit/tonne," it said.
